subtitle: Sign in to your Asha workspace
trustNotice: Authorized access only. Activity may be monitored.

demo.title: Try it free for 10 minutes
demo.subtitle: Enter your e-mail and an instant demo workspace starts. No account needed.
demo.notice: One demo per e-mail and per device. Repeat attempts are logged.

showcase.headline: Every desktop your team needs, <gold>in one browser tab</gold>.

desktops.title: Windows and Linux, one sign‑in
desktops.body: RDP, VNC, SSH and isolated container desktops behind a single account.

zeroTrust.title: No VPN, zero trust
zeroTrust.body: Only the picture travels. The clipboard follows your organization’s rules.

live.title: Help when it counts
live.body: Admins can watch or take over a session, and users always see when they do.

showcase.lead: Asha streams Windows and Linux desktops, apps and container workspaces straight to the browser. No VPN, no install, and nothing is left behind on the device.

errors.enterEmailFirst: Enter your e-mail or username first, then use your passkey.
errors.invalidCredentials: That username or password is not right.
errors.orgHint: Part of a specific organization? Add its name.
errors.codeInvalid: That code is not right. Use the current code from your app.
errors.codeReused: That code was just used. Wait for the next one; it changes every 30 seconds.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Try again.

request.title: Request <gold>access</gold>
request.subtitle: Ask an administrator for a demo or test account.
request.reasonPlaceholder: Briefly: who you are and what you'd like to evaluate.
request.reasonHint: Optional, but it speeds up the decision.
request.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. You'll use it once your request is approved.
request.approvalNotice: Nothing is created yet. An administrator reviews every request before an account is activated.

done.title: Request received
done.body: If this address can be used, an administrator will review your request.
done.next: Once approved, sign in with the e-mail and password you just chose. If you already have an account, sign in instead — no second one is created.

disabled.title: Sign-up is closed
disabled.body: This deployment does not accept account requests right now. Please contact your administrator.

showcase.headline: Request an account, <gold>approved by a human</gold>.

submit.title: Send your request
submit.body: Tell us who you are and pick your password.

review.title: An admin reviews it
review.body: Every request is checked before anything is created.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Once approved, your account is live — no e-mail round-trip.

request.usernameHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
